request_mail.subject: Water under my kitchen sink!!
request_mail.body:
Hello,

There is water under my kitchen sink and it is getting worse. I put a salad bowl under it, but it is my good salad bowl.

Can someone come as soon as possible? I am only home in the mornings. In the afternoons I volunteer at the library.

Thank you,
Margaret Hollis

messages.body: psst. saw the Hollis mail come in. whatever you do, don't send Stan. Duke and Stan have history. there was a ladder involved.

replies.answer: np. we look out for each other here. unlike the coffee machine.
we don't talk about the ladder.

messages.body: wait. did you just put STAN on Hollis?? Duke is going to chase him up the ladder again. rebook it with Rita, trust me

replies.answer: good call. Stan owes you one. he will never know.

outcomes.feedback: Mrs. Hollis called to say the morning appointment is perfect. She called us "a gem". I am choosing to believe she meant me.
outcomes.otherwise_feedback: Mrs. Hollis called. She is not home in the afternoons. She volunteers at the library. She then explained the entire library schedule to me. Forty minutes.

outcomes.feedback: Good pick on the technician, too.
outcomes.otherwise_feedback: You sent a heating guy to a leaking sink. He will look at it, call a plumber and drive out again. Two trips. I am not angry. I am disappointed.

outcomes.feedback: And fast. Love to see it.
outcomes.otherwise_feedback: It is a leaking sink. By the time we get there, she will have a pond. Maybe a duck.

outcomes.feedback: Also, Duke chased Stan up his ladder again. Stan is fine. The ladder is not. Mrs. Hollis sent a cake to apologize. To Stan, not to us.
outcomes.otherwise_feedback: And nobody got chased up a ladder. By Hollis standards, that is a great day.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: Mrs. Hollis
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey champ,

Quick one about Mrs. Hollis and her sink.
feedback_mail.outro:
My door is always open. Literally. The hinge is broken.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: Mrs. Hollis?
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

Mrs. Hollis called again. Something about a salad bowl. Is she scheduled yet?

Appointment in ServicePlan, confirmation mail to her, and put it in your calendar. You know the drill. Or you will. Tomorrow.

Gary
